resources.string: In Accessibility Settings, open Downloaded apps or Installed services, select Screenly, and turn on Use Screenly. Return here to check the status.

After enabling the service, open Android Settings. Tap the floating Screenly bubble, then Guide Me, and enter a goal such as How do I change my font size? Manually tap the highlighted control; Screenly will check the next screen. Open Guide Me to recheck, stop, confirm completion, or use the manual picker. Drag the bubble to move it. Only diagnostic counts and timings are logged.

Screen observations stay in memory. Screenshots are processed only during authorized guidance or questions. Password and sensitive nodes are skipped; editable values are omitted. Screenly does not save screen contents, use the network, or tap for you.

Inspects accessible interface elements in other apps and displays a floating assistant for manual highlighting. Private text and images are not logged. Password and sensitive nodes are skipped, and editable values are omitted. No screen contents are saved or sent over the network; Screenly does not tap for you.
Screenly assistant. Tap to open actions; drag to move.
On-device AI chat is not available in this prototype yet. Use Guide Me to manually select and highlight controls.
AI screen explanations are not implemented yet. Guide Me can highlight a selected control without tapping it for you.
